# Unity

Build Discord Activities with the **Unity** game engine. This template provides the integration layer between Unity WebGL builds and Discord's Embedded App SDK.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://unity.com/" title="Unity" description="Professional game development engine." />
  <Card href="/docs/discord-activities" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-activities/unity
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Unity Setup

1. Create your Unity project separately
2. Configure it for WebGL build target
3. Build and copy the output to `/public/unity`
4. The Robo.js wrapper handles Discord SDK integration

<Files>
  <Folder name="public" defaultOpen disabled>
    <Folder name="unity" note="Unity WebGL build" disabled />

  <Folder name="src" defaultOpen disabled>

## Discord SDK Integration

The template includes JavaScript bridge code that:

- Initializes the Discord SDK
- Handles authentication
- Passes user/guild data to Unity
- Manages activity lifecycle events

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
